notes: Genre: Adventure. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
A cast/interact, B jump/back
Cast spells by selecting them and aiming at targets
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Flipendo, Lumos, Incendio, Diffindo (cut), Spongify (bounce), Skurge (clear ectoplasm), Avifors, Mimblewimble and more learned through the year.
widgets.label: Spells

widgets.text:
Spiders hate Lumos/light; Skurge cleans ghost slime.
The Basilisk finale: avoid its gaze and use the Sword of Gryffindor.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Hogwarts castle, Diagon Alley, the grounds and Forbidden Forest, the Chamber of Secrets.
widgets.label: Places

widgets.text:
Bertie Bott's beans are the currency (buy from Fred & George).
Chocolate frogs heal.
Wizard cards and secret items around the castle.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Famous Wizard Cards: many hidden, some sold by the twins.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Learn the year's spells, solve who opened the Chamber, and defeat the Basilisk.
widgets.label: Goal
